# CVGenie ATS — AI Resume Builder & Career Copilot

> CVGenie (https://cvgenieats.com) is an AI-powered resume builder and ATS optimization platform that tailors professional resumes and cover letters to job descriptions in under 2 minutes.

## Core Capabilities
- **ATS Keyword Matching**: Analyzes target job postings and matches candidate skills, quantifiable metrics, and role-specific keywords.
- **Two-Pass AI Engine**: Generates an initial optimized draft followed by a strict ATS layout compliance pass (single-column, standard headers, high parse rate).
- **Cover Letter Generation**: Generates targeted, role-specific cover letters aligned with the tailored resume.
- **Multi-Format Export**: Clean downloads in PDF, Microsoft Word (.docx), and Plain Text (.txt).
- **Interview Preparation**: Generates mock behavioral, skills-based, and role-specific interview questions with answering strategies.

## Pricing & Tiers
- **Free Tier**: 3 AI Resume Wishes per month with standard ATS optimization.
- **Pro Plan ($9.99/mo)**: Unlimited AI generations, priority AI speed, watermark-free exports, and complete resume version history.
